description: TCL T-Chord 11-Slot Codec Latency Calibration & Joint Acoustic Configuration Table

crossover_network.rationale: Prevents TV micro-transducer excursion overload (>1.2mm) below 400Hz and eliminates plastic chassis buzz, allocating chest resonance strictly to Q95K subwoofer array

blauert_directional_filter.rationale: Activates human pinna directional band (Vorn-Oben) to elevate dialogue phantom center directly to display screen midline

icld_level_balance.rationale: Per Wallis & Lee (JAES 2015), TV speaker serves as an acoustic elevation anchor without overpowering the main soundbar soundstage

peq_filters.description: High-Pass Filter Stage 2 (Cascaded to form Linkwitz-Riley 24dB/oct)
